cosmos_v01:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE research comparison board with TWO equal-width stacked 16:9 landscape panels, overall portrait 8:9. Small unobtrusive labels A and B only, no other writing. These are equally powerful HIGH-INTENSITY cosmic endpoint visions for an original dark magical-girl project, not mild hallway tests. Strong TV-anime background/concept-art visual language, bold large masses, readable value grouping, controlled detail, sacred grandeur and recognizable mandala-like cosmological organization are welcome. No science-fiction HUD.

BOTH PANELS: same near-human-height wide viewpoint and approximately the same composition. More than two thirds of each scene is a directly exposed deep cosmos. A vast central inverted-mountain-shaped cool near-black mass, two nested square spatial tiers and enormous concentric stellar-group arcs extend beyond frame. Strata are massive with thick sides, visible underside and real occlusion, not thin glass, floating decorative furniture or simple neon line art. Preserve a strong central vertical dark cleft with intermittent cold-white rim light. An irregular worn Hong Kong public walkway fragment and short battered handrail remain at the bottom as human scale cues. Two modestly dressed anonymous human figures about one fifth of panel height: one plants the rear foot, bends the knee, counterweights the hip and reaches to support the second figure's forearm. Show the actual contact and physical weight, not worship or a static raised-hands pose. The planted-leg/hip vector and shoulder/forearm vector align visibly with two immense cosmic strata; the universe continues beyond them, not emitted from them. Keep heads, hands and arm contours legible. Figures are study placeholders, not new approved character identities.

STARS AND LIGHT: cool near-black, high contrast, low saturation with legible near-black planes; avoid bright cobalt, purple nebula and gold. Three depth-separated curved bands of stars, outer band denser, inner band sparser. Roughly half the dark cosmos remains star-free negative space. A few small cold-white bright stars; around a dozen irregular small stellar clusters arranged as short arcs/wedges with black channels separating them; very fine dense stardust in only two or three long curved bands. Stars behind solid strata are occluded. Not uniform space wallpaper. The human contact has a clear continuous lit shape, while the cosmos has tiny brighter points, so both scales remain readable. ONE tiny compact dark-crimson patch on an occluded side face near and behind the hand contact; less than about one percent of scene, provisional composition target. No red fog, red flood, blood, all-over red dots, or red energy beam.

PANEL A, MUTUALLY CONTAINING COSMIC STRATA: three differently oriented EXISTING thick cut faces each contain a complete but differently organized cosmic depth. Large front face: central mass with surrounding star order. Very narrow angled right side face: another complete spatial order visibly receding more deeply than its external size permits. A lower face has its own obliquely seen depth with partial foreground occlusion. They must NOT be duplicate miniature mandala logos, flat inset graphics, three glass windows or travel portals. Distinct orientation, side thickness, overlapping matter, differently scaled interior distances. The relationship is local spaces containing full cosmic organization, not copies of the same picture.

PANEL B, ONE COHERENT COSMIC SECTION: preserve equally immense central mass, sacred axis, human action, palette, red location and stellar intensity. Replace the three containing interiors with continuous solid faces. One single coherent inverted-mountain section and three outward extending cosmic strata obey a shared orientation, with immense surrounding star groups. Do not make B duller, emptier or a normal corridor. Compare two complete high-intensity artistic intentions, not good versus bad.

No invented scripture, readable Sanskrit, extra limbs, replicated people, shrine throne, glitter everywhere, photoreal astronaut or spaceship. Intentional awe and human agency coexist. Research concept, not canon adoption.
cosmos_v02:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT the provided research board. Use ONLY the lower panel B as the target; output that scene alone as a wide 16:9 image, no panel A, no labels.
Preserve B's exact camera, enormous central inverted mountain, sacred central axis, cosmic scale, circular star rings, cool near-black low-chroma palette, two human figures' braced support action, railing and foreground. Do NOT reduce the intensity or replace the cosmos with a grey room.
PRIMARY CHANGE: restructure the intermediate ledges into TWO enormous, visibly thick SQUARE perimeter terraces in the same perspective, nested around the central mountain, enclosed by the vast existing circular stellar field. The square terraces have clearly visible corners, deep black side thickness and actual depth separation; their distant corners pass behind and are occluded by the mountain. This must read as central mountain, square cosmic tiers, circular outer cosmos in real 3D space, not thin glowing HUD squares, not windows, not floating picture frames. Retain a strong forearm-directed diagonal and foot-bracing diagonal in nearby ledges. Keep the existing mountain organic enough to retain its intimidating weight.
SECONDARY PALETTE REPAIR: replace the small branching red glowing crack on the mountain's lower right face with ONE small dark matte crimson surface patch in the same location, part hidden by the foreground rock plane. Broad dry opaque surface, not light emission, not fissures, no red veins or fog. Keep the rest of the image as close as possible to B. No new religious figures, writing or symbols.
pattern_v01:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE graphic art-direction research board with white background, 3 columns and 2 rows, wide landscape layout. Flat black silhouettes, bold clean edges, large open white bays. Only labels A B C above columns.
Define the shared motif carefully: one connected asymmetric open bracket with a thick back spine, a long upper shoulder bending inward once into a short hook, and a shorter pointed lower shoulder. Staggered tips form a diagonal SIDE opening. The white interior bay stays visibly open to the background. NOT a closed hole. This hooked long shoulder plus short shoulder plus oblique mouth is the family identity.
TOP ROW compare three truly different compositions, equal visual footprint:
A: a linear chain of THREE progressively smaller bracket cells joined only at the ends of their back spines. All three mouths face right. Three open white bays. Asymmetric, powerful rhythmic band.
B: TWO equal cells mirrored face to face across a strong vertical central axis, mouths facing the centre, clearly separated. Intentional sacred heraldic symmetry, large central gap, no enclosing circle.
C: THREE separate equal cells rotated by 120 degrees with their mouths inward around an empty centre. Three open channels connect centre to exterior, ritual flower feel, no outer circle.
BOTTOM ROW show the same A chain in three material/style treatments, one below each column: first rounded soft shoulders and smooth liquid-like black mass; second narrow elongated compact silhouette with ONE cell, not multiple parallel threads; third two heavy angular faceted cells with crisp 45 degree corners. The silhouettes should still preserve long hooked shoulder, short shoulder and open oblique mouth. These are art candidates not official powers or religious symbols.
No particles, no gradients, no glow, no fake writing, no extra ornamental runes, no character costumes, no drawn spell circles, no tiny detail clutter. Make the hooked interior anatomy obvious enough for another artist to redraw. Flat design construction, not a glossy logo presentation.
pattern_v02:

Replace the three detached horizontally arranged C-shaped marks with one vertically stacked, connected construction. Use clean flat-black silhouettes with no added texture, glow, particles, outer frame, or new symbols. Keep the complete replacement comfortably inside the original upper-left panel.
